headline: Medgar Evers outpaces the conference in overall wins
dek: Medgar Evers College posted eleven wins, three draws, and three losses across all competition, more wins than any other CUNYAC program. Its attack produced 51 goals while conceding 26, though Baruch College sits atop the conference table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring volume diverges from the conference standings: Medgar Evers College has 51 goals across all matches, more than CCNY and Lehman College combined, while table leader Baruch College sits in the middle of the distribution.

wire.line: York (N.Y.) conceded 100 goals across all matches, more than CCNY and Hunter College combined.
